title: Don't Say Good Luck
plot_overview: A high school musical lead is ready for the spotlight, but growing challenges at home begin competing with auditions, rehearsals, friendships, and everyday teenage concerns. As school life continues around her, she must find a way to balance the excitement of performing with a difficult family situation.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy heartfelt coming-of-age stories with school performances, family drama, and gentle emotion; Not for you if you want bold surprises or a radically original take.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt coming-of-age story; authentic lead performance; emotionally grounded relationships | Cons: familiar genre formula; predictable developments; occasionally too obvious
